pages.text: I disagree with the primary researcher's interpretation of the resonance differential. They see evidence of intentional design. I see evidence of natural harmonic coincidence in a world full of resonant stone. We have been arguing about this for four months. I am beginning to suspect that we are both correct and that this distinction does not matter as much as either of us thought.

I am writing this separately because I do not want it in the shared record. The sarcophagite blocks damp the resonance. We know this. What we have not said aloud is that this means the resonance is something that can be damped. Which means it is something that is going somewhere. Which means somewhere is being filled with it. I did not sleep last night.
